name: Austria
administering_agency: The government of each Land (Landesregierung), under rules set by the Federal Ministry of the Interior

format.notes: Six questions from each of three areas: the democratic order, the history of Austria, the history of the Land. Four answers are offered, of which one to three are right; one point per fully correct question. Passed with at least half the points in each area, or two thirds of all points (12 of 18).
